newsitem.title: USA: Mellon unit files for $1 mln in certificates.
newsitem.headline: Mellon unit files for $1 mln in certificates.

text.p: Mellon Residential Funding Corp, a unit of Mellon Bank Corp, filed Thursday with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $1 million in mortgage pass-through certificates.
Net proceeds will be applied against the purchase price of the mortgage loans, Mellon said in the filing.
The filing was made in a nominal amount. In practice, companies usually amend registration statements later on to reflect a bigger amount of securities to be sold.
Mellon, based in Pittsburgh, Penn., is a national banking association.
